The Quran

 ۞CRAFTED WITH INTENTION

A book. A connection.
A little less noise.

Mushaf is a personal project by Sami Mustafa, designed and built together with ChatGPT. A familiar Quran, reimagined as a calm digital reading space.

The complete Arabic text, page boundaries and word glyphs are sourced from Quran.com. The reader uses their QCF V2 calligraphy across all 604 Madani pages. The cover, book, stand and page ornament are original digital artwork inspired by a traditional Mushaf.

Arabic text is preserved from the source. Bookmarks and reading position are saved on this device. This project is independently made and is not affiliated with Quran.com.
